Everyday Meat Loaf
By: Lady Catherine ...
Published: Thursday, February 25, 2010 - 12:36pm

Ingredients




2 pounds ground beef
2 eggs – lightly beaten
1 cup oats
1 cup frozen peas & carrots
1 small onion – chopped
1/4 cup parsley – chopped
3 cloves garlic – crushed & chopped
2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce
2 tablespoons Ketchup

Preparation

1 Preheat Oven 350 degrees: 2 In a large bowl thoroughly mix all ingredients (except the ketchup and 1 tablespoon of the Worcestershire sauce). 3 Mold meat into a pan and in a small bowl combine the ketchup and 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce and smooth over the top of the meat loaf. 4 Bake in oven for about 50-60 minutes.

About


Enjoy with Love,
Catherine
